messages:
Anna: Quick follow-up re: streaming retries. Proposal: emit compact progress tokens mid-stream so callers can request a resume instead of a blind retry.

Raj: How compact? binary blob or ascii header?

Anna: ASCII header/trailer so proxies/clients can read it without parsing frames. Example: `x-rw-progress: v1;tok_idx=1234;sig=abc123`. Signed HMAC, short.

Mike: That helps distinguish committed output from in-flight tokens. But we must define semantics: token index vs byte offset?

Anna: Use model output token index (monotonic). Simpler across tokenizers than bytes. We document canonical tokenization we use for offsets.

Olivia: Doc question: what do we guarantee if a client resumes with a checkpoint that points between tokens? Partial token cases will be messy.

Tim: We only allow resume at checkpoint boundaries (we emit only at safe boundaries like sentence/EOS markers). SDKs should only send checkpoints straight from trailer. No client-side made-up offsets.

Natalie: Rollout concern: not all routes should enable this. Suggest route config: `emit_progress_checkpoints: true|false` and default off.

Raj: Observability: add metrics: `edge.checkpoint.emitted_total`, `edge.checkpoint.resume_success_total`, `edge.checkpoint.resume_fallback_total`. Also histogram for resume latency delta.

Mike: Tracing: create a span attribute `retry.resume.used_checkpoint=true/false` and annotate which checkpoint token was accepted (redacted).

Anna: Security: use KMS-backed HMAC keys rotated weekly. Checkpoint sig contains key id like `kid=2026-03-01`. Verification is stateless at gateway.

Olivia: Billing: how to avoid double charging if client resumes and server replays tokens?

Tim: Billing hook: runtime emits a billing watermark at checkpoint time. If resume happens and checkpoint matches, charge only for tokens after watermark. Routing/billing service must support dedupe by checkpoint signature.

Natalie: Edge cases: model variant mismatch. If upstream variant can't resume at tok_idx N, gateway should attempt compatible variants first then fallback to full restart. If none compatible, return `412 PRECONDITION_FAILED` with `x-rw-err: checkpoint_incompat`.

Raj: Good to include an SDK handshake snippet in RFC. Pseudocode: ```js
// client receives trailer
const cp = trailer['x-rw-progress']
// on reconnect
POST /v1/resume { checkpoint: cp }
// server validates sig, finds compatible variant or returns 412
```

Mike: Also include a small state diagram: emit -> client stores -> retry-> attempt resume -> success|fallback. Keep it minimal in RFC.

Anna: Implementation plan: (1) RFC extension with header format and semantics, (2) opt-in route flag, (3) runtime signing + KMS, (4) metrics/tracing work, (5) billing/dedupe integration.

Natalie: I can open PR for the route flag and basic metrics. Tim can own billing hook. Raj will add tracing changes.

deploy-bot: Deployed branch `edge-prog-token` to staging (rev b4c1f). Basic checkpoint emit enabled on a few test routes. Smoke tests OK.

Olivia: One more UX thought: make SDKs surface a `canResume` boolean to apps so they can show "resume" in UI vs starting fresh.

Anna: Nice UX idea. We'll add to SDK appendix. Thanks all :thumbsup:
